questions.question: Who coined the word mitochondrion in 1898?
questions.statement: The word mitochondrion was coined by Carl Benda in 1898.
questions.quote: The word mitochondrion was coined by Carl Benda in 1898.

questions.question: Which mitochondrial compartment contains the citric acid cycle?
questions.statement: The citric acid cycle runs in the matrix of the mitochondrion.
questions.quote: Matrix: the space inside the inner membrane. The citric acid cycle runs here.

questions.question: How many genes are encoded by the human mitochondrial genome?
questions.statement: The human mitochondrial genome encodes 37 genes.

questions.question: In what year was the chemiosmotic hypothesis proposed?
questions.statement: The chemiosmotic hypothesis was proposed in 1961.
questions.quote: The chemiosmotic hypothesis was proposed in 1961.

questions.question: Why is FADH2 worth fewer ATP than NADH?
options: It skips complex I and pumps fewer protons
It is only produced during glycolysis
It is used up by the citric acid cycle
questions.statement: FADH2 is worth less ATP because it skips complex I and pumps fewer protons.
questions.quote: FADH2 is worth less because it skips complex I and so pumps fewer protons.
